perks.name: Outlaw

perks.name: Heal Clip

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Exhaustive Research
perks.desc: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 150 from 19 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/09YmSx1l928T7hFnj7Kvxi?si=eb827f2ac1974a14) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor add groups both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with solar builds. Agape, as a heavy burst frame, provides the best damage output against minors and offers as its intrinsic perk a little additional flinch resistance when ADSed. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are middling, with a boost at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that Range of 64 translates to 21.76m hipfire and 34.82m ADS before damage drop-off, 28 Stability is ×1.0150 flinch resistance, 29 Handling is 0.39s ready, 0.28s ADS and 0.43s stow speed, 21 Reload Speed is a 3.13s reload and Magazine Size is 14 (max 28). For barrel and magazine perk choices, Agape desperately needs Handling and Reload Speed as a priority. If you want to use Heal Clip in the first trait perk column, for the ×2 Cure (140 HP) and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m when you finish a reload within 5.3s after a kill, you really do need to sort the reload out or the window is really short, and if you're in trouble you'll likely be dead before the animation's complete. Pairing Firefly in the second column is great in this respect - as well as the solar explosion in a 4m radius on a crit kill, you also get +50 Reload Speed (+55 when enhanced). The Exhaustive Research Origin Trait is very good for PvE - ADS for 1s at an enemy up to 60m away, and the next shot will fire a mini-rocket - these are affected by and can proc rocket-based perks and traits too - with a 5s cooldown. If you're interested, Agape (pronounced Ah-gar-pay) is a Greek word for the highest form of love, characterised by selflessness and unconditional care for others. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
